title: 同じ期待動作の入力違いはtest.eachで表現する

question.instructions: Classify whether repeated test cases in this file follow the project rule that cases verifying the same expected behavior with different inputs should use test.each.

criteria.violation: Two or more separate test cases repeat substantially the same Act and Assert structure and differ mainly in input values or expected values, so they should be represented with test.each.
criteria.compliant: Repeated cases are already represented with test.each, or separate tests verify materially different behaviors that deserve independent test cases.
criteria.not_applicable: The file has no repeated test cases representing the same behavior with different inputs or expected values.
criteria.insufficient_context: The available source does not make it possible to determine whether superficially similar tests represent the same expected behavior.
